chapterInfo.content:
135
Nyankopɔn tumi ne ahoni mmerɛyɛ
1Monyi AWURADE ayɛ.
Monyi AWURADE din ayɛ,
AWURADE nkoa, monyi no ayɛ,
2mo a mogyina AWURADE fie,
yɛn Nyankopɔn fie adihɔ.
3Monyi AWURADE ayɛ, na AWURADE yɛ,
monto dwom mma ne din, na ɛyɛ dɛ.
4 # Eks 19.5-6; Deut 7.6 Na AWURADE ayi Yakob afa,
ɔde Israel ayɛ ne deɛ.
5 # Dwom 86.8 Na me deɛ, menim sɛ AWURADE so,
na yɛn wura sene anyame nyinaa.
6Biribiara a AWURADE pɛ no, ɔyɛ,
ɔsoro ne fam,
ɛpo ne abunu nyinaa mu.
7 # Yer 10.13 Ɔma amununkum firi asase ano ba,
ɔyɛ anyinam ma osutorɔ,
ɔyi mframa firi ne korabea.
8 # Eks 12.29 Ɔkum Misraim mmakan
firi nnipa so kɔsii mmoa so.
9 # Dwom 78.43-52 Ɔsomaa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ
baa wo, Misraim, mfimfini,
Farao ne ne nkoa nyinaa so.
10Ɔbobɔɔ amanaman pii,
na ɔkumm ahemfo atumfoɔ,
11 # Num 21.21-35 Amorifoɔ hene Sihon,
ne Basan hene Og,
ne Kanaan ahennie nyinaa,
12 # Yos 12 na ɔde wɔn asase maa sɛ awunnyadeɛ,
ɔde yɛɛ ne man Israel awunnyadeɛ.
13 # Dwom 102.12 AWURADE, wo din wɔ hɔ daa,
AWURADE, wo nkaeɛ tena awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.
14 # Deut 32.36, 43 Na AWURADE bɛbu ne man bem,
na ɔbɛhu ne nkoa mmɔbɔ.
15Amanaman ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ,
nnipa nsa ano nnwuma.
16Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wɔnkasa,
wɔwɔ ani, nanso wɔnhunu adeɛ,
17wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm,
nso home biara nni wɔn anomu.
18Wɔn a wɔyɛ wɔn bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn ara,
obiara a ɔde ne ho to wɔn soɔ no.
19 # Dwom 118.2-4 Israel fiefoɔ, monhyira AWURADE,
Aaron fiefoɔ, monhyira AWURADE.
20Lewi fiefoɔ, monhyira AWURADE,
mo a mosuro AWURADE, monhyira AWURADE.
21Wɔmfiri Sion nhyira AWURADE
a ɔte Yerusalem no,
monyi AWURADE ayɛ.

Monyi AWURADE din ayɛ,
AWURADE nkoa, monyi no ayɛ,
mo a mogyina AWURADE fie,
yɛn Nyankopɔn fie adihɔ.

monto dwom mma ne din, na ɛyɛ dɛ.

ɔde Israel ayɛ ne deɛ.
Na me deɛ, menim sɛ AWURADE so,
na yɛn wura sene anyame nyinaa.

ɔsoro ne fam,
ɛpo ne abunu nyinaa mu.
Ɔma amununkum firi asase ano ba,

Ɔkum Misraim mmakan
firi nnipa so kɔsii mmoa so.
Ɔsomaa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ
baa wo, Misraim, mfimfini,
Farao ne ne nkoa nyinaa so.
Ɔbobɔɔ amanaman pii,
na ɔkumm ahemfo atumfoɔ,
Amorifoɔ hene Sihon,
ne Basan hene Og,
ne Kanaan ahennie nyinaa,
na ɔde wɔn asase maa sɛ awunnyadeɛ,
ɔde yɛɛ ne man Israel awunnyadeɛ.
AWURADE, wo din wɔ hɔ daa,
AWURADE, wo nkaeɛ tena awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.
Na AWURADE bɛbu ne man bem,
na ɔbɛhu ne nkoa mmɔbɔ.
Amanaman ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ,
nnipa nsa ano nnwuma.
Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wɔnkasa,
wɔwɔ ani, nanso wɔnhunu adeɛ,
wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm,
nso home biara nni wɔn anomu.
Wɔn a wɔyɛ wɔn bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn ara,
obiara a ɔde ne ho to wɔn soɔ no.
Israel fiefoɔ, monhyira AWURADE,
Aaron fiefoɔ, monhyira AWURADE.
Lewi fiefoɔ, monhyira AWURADE,
mo a mosuro AWURADE, monhyira AWURADE.
Wɔmfiri Sion nhyira AWURADE
a ɔte Yerusalem no,
monyi AWURADE ayɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
